delete.description: Deletes the album with the given id and returns it with its artist. The album is kept but no longer listed. While the album has tracks the delete is refused with 409, unless `cascade=true`, which deletes the tracks too, all or nothing. An unknown or deleted id returns 404. Requires the admin role.
